name: 30yr-uptime
description: While Claude works, reminds you to stand up, drink water, stretch, and do lunges or squats.

waitSeconds.title: Wait before nudging (seconds)
waitSeconds.description: How long Claude must be working before a break is suggested. 1 to 3600; an invalid value uses the default.

intervalMinutes.title: Reminder interval (minutes)
intervalMinutes.description: Also remind you this often, even if Claude is idle. 0 turns it off; otherwise 1 to 1440. An invalid value uses the default.

stand.title: Break: Stand up
stand.description: Include the "Stand up" break. Turn off the moves you can't or don't want to do.

water.title: Break: Drink water
water.description: Include the "Drink water" break. Turn off the moves you can't or don't want to do.

squat.title: Break: Squats
squat.description: Include the "Squats" break. Turn off the moves you can't or don't want to do.

lunge.title: Break: Lunges
lunge.description: Include the "Lunges" break. Turn off the moves you can't or don't want to do.

stretch.title: Break: Stretch
stretch.description: Include the "Stretch" break. Turn off the moves you can't or don't want to do.

eyes.title: Break: Eye rest (20-20-20)
eyes.description: Include the "Eye rest (20-20-20)" break. Turn off the moves you can't or don't want to do.

walk.title: Break: Walk
walk.description: Include the "Walk" break. Turn off the moves you can't or don't want to do.
